Sawaal 1: Kya operator ko **ApniBus Business App** ke liye alag se paise dene hote hain?

[CHIP: monthly|Haan, 500 Rupees monthly subscription] [CHIP: perbus|Haan, per-bus monthly charges lagte hain] [CHIP: free|Nahi, ye POS machine ke sath bilkul free hai] [CHIP: onetime|Haan, one-time payment of 2000 Rupees]
Nahi, ye POS machine ke sath bilkul free hai

Correct! Great job. 👍

Sawaal 2: Business App ka main benefit kya hai jo operators ke sath deal close karne mein help karta hai?

[CHIP: music|It provides music entertainment] [CHIP: live|It shows real-time collection reports live on their phone] [CHIP: print|It prints physical tickets] [CHIP: replace|It replaces the conductor entirely]
It shows real-time collection reports live on their phone

Correct! You nailed it. 🎯

Congratulations! 🎉 Aapne saare videos aur slides successfully confirm kar liye hain. Ab aapka **Phase 2 (Grooming)** unlock ho chuka hai!

[CHIP: Grooming shuru karein]
Grooming shuru karein

🚀 **Welcome to Phase 2 Grooming — Step 1: Product Deep-Dive**

Ye hain ApniBus POS machine ke 7 main features:

1. **Instant Digital Ticketing**: 2 second mein thermal ticket print.
2. **Offline & Online Mode**: Bina network ke bhi chalega; signal aane pe auto-sync.
3. **Long Battery Life**: 24 ghante nonstop battery backup.
4. **Rugged Hardware**: Heavy drop-tested body.
5. **Free Business App**: Owner ko phone pe live collection report bilkul FREE.
6. **Revenue Leakage Control**: Conductor cash theft par full rok.
7. **24x7 Support & Replacement Warranty**.

Step 2 pe jaane ke liye niche click karein! 👇

[CHIP: Next Step — Objection Handling]
Next Step — Objection Handling

Grahak ke objections ka jawab dena hi ek ache BD ki pehchan hai. Hum iske liye **A-A-A-A Framework** ka use karte hain:
1. **Acknowledge** (Grahak ki baat ko sahi batana, unhe comfortable karna)
2. **Ask** (Unse sawaal pooch kar unke dhandhe ka nuksan nikalna)
3. **Address** (ApniBus ke benefits se us nuksan ko control karna batana)
4. **Advance** (Agla step lena - setup ke liye bolna)

Aap kis common objection ka jawab seekhna chahte hain?

[CHIP: Next Step — Fix My Pitch (Role Reversal)] [CHIP: Machine bahut mehngi hai] [CHIP: Pehle se button machine hai] [CHIP: Conductor nahi chala payega]
Machine bahut mehngi hai

Is objection ko **A-A-A-A Framework** se aise handle karein:

1. **Acknowledge:** *"Bhaiya, aap bilkul sahi keh rahe hain. Jab maine pehli baar is machine ka cost dekha tha, toh mujhe bhi laga tha ki ye thodi mehngi hai."*
2. **Ask:** *"Achha bhaiya, aapki ek bus ka roz ka average collection kitna ho jata hai? Lagbhag 10,000?"*
3. **Address:** *"Aap toh jaante hi hain, manual ticketing mein 5% se 10% ka leakage (chori/galti) aam baat hai. Yaani har mahine lagbhag 15,000 ka nuksan. ApniBus POS machine aur free Business App lagane ke baad, aapka har ek ticket digital record hoga aur saara collection aapke paas aayega. Yaani machine ka kharch toh pehle hi hafte mein nikal aayega!"*
4. **Advance:** *"Toh bhaiya, chaliye iska setup aaj hi karwa dete hain aur kal se aapki bus smart ho jayegi?"*

Aapko ye tarika kaisa laga? Kya aap kisi aur objection ka jawab seekhna chahte hain?

[CHIP: Pehle se button machine hai] [CHIP: Conductor cannot manage it]
Pehle se button machine hai

Purani button machines sirf ticket print karti hain, business manage nahi karti. **A-A-A-A Framework** se iska jawab:

1. **Acknowledge:** *"Bilkul sahi bhaiya, button machine se ticket toh ban jata hai aur wo sasti bhi hoti hai."*
2. **Ask:** *"Lekin bhaiya, kya wo button machine aapko ye bata sakti hai ki kis trip mein kitne passengers the, aur conductor ke paas abhi kitna cash hona chahiye?"*
3. **Address:** *"ApniBus smart machine sirf ticket print nahi karti. Ye direct humare Business App se judi hai. Conductor jaise hi ticket banayega, aapko apne mobile par live collection, passenger counts, aur trip details dikhayi degi. Aapko conductor par depend nahi hona padega. Aap aisa samjho ki button waali machine normal feature phone hai aur touch waali machine smartphone hai."*
4. **Advance:** *"Toh purani button machine ko badlein aur smart ApniBus lagayein?"*

[CHIP: pitch|Fix My Pitch (Next Step)] [CHIP: roleplay|Customer Roleplay] [CHIP: Machine bahut mehngi hai]
Fix My Pitch (Next Step)

Rohit, aaj pitch pe kaam karenge — par thoda alag tarike se. 🔄

Do round honge:
* **Round 1 (Role Reversal)**: *Aap* bus owner banoge, aur *main* salesperson banunga. Aap dekhoge ki achha pitch kaisa lagta hai — customer ki kursi pe baith kar.
* **Round 2 (Swap)**: Ulta. Main bus owner banunga, aur aap pitch karoge.

Round 1 sabse important hai. Kyun? Kyunki jab tak aapko pata nahi ki **customer ko kya feel hota hai**, tab tak aap sirf ratta maar rahe ho.

Ready? Main aapko aapka character deta hoon. 🎭

[CHIP: Chalo shuru karein] [CHIP: Ye kaise kaam karega?]
Chalo shuru karein

🎭 **Aapka character — dhyan se padho:**

* **Naam:** Rajesh Yadav, umar 48
* **Business:** 4 buses, Ludhiana–Chandigarh route, 12 saal se
* **Padhai:** 10th pass. Hisaab-kitaab register mein, haath se.
* **Mood:** Busy. Thoda shakki. Salesman roz aate hain.

**Aapke dimaag mein ye chal raha hai:**
* "Mera kaam theek chal raha hai, naya kharcha kyun?"
* "Machine kharab ho gayi toh? Kaun theek karega?"
* "Conductor padha likha nahi hai, chala paayega?"
* **Sabse bada dard:** Conductor roz thoda paisa maar raha hai, par proof nahi hai. 🔑

**Kaise act karna hai:**
1. Shuruaat mein thanda response do. Bahut interested mat dikho.
2. Kam se kam do baar objection karo (price, aur kaam chal raha hai pe).
3. Jab koi baat sach mein chubhe — tab honestly react karo.

Ready Rajesh ji? Main aapke office mein aa raha hoon… 🎬

[CHIP: Ready, shuru karo]
Ready, shuru karo

**Coach (as Salesperson):** Namaste sir, Rajesh ji aap hi hain na? Main Amit, ApniBus se. Do minute maangunga, usse zyada nahi. Chalega? 🤝

[CHIP: Haan bhai bolo. Jaldi bolna, bus nikalne wali hai.] [CHIP: Abhi time nahi hai, baad mein aana.]
Haan bhai bolo. Jaldi bolna, bus nikalne wali hai.

**Coach (as Salesperson):** Bilkul sir, seedha point pe aata hoon. Ek baat poochhun — aapki 4 buses hain na? **Roz ka collection aapko kaise pata chalta hai?**

[CHIP: Conductor shaam ko deta hai, register mein likh lete hain]
Conductor shaam ko deta hai, register mein likh lete hain

**Coach (as Salesperson):** Samajh gaya sir. Aur ye jo paisa wo aapko deta hai — **aapko kaise pata ki poora hai?**

*(pause — bolna mat)*

Sir main sach bataun, main is line mein 6 saal se hoon. Har operator jisse main milta hoon, unke saath yahi problem hai. Koi bolta nahi, par shaq sabko rehta hai. Aur mahine ke end mein aath-das hazaar ka farak aa jaata hai — kisi ko pata hi nahi chalta.

[CHIP: Hmm... wo toh hai] [CHIP: Aapki machine kya karegi isme?]
Aapki machine kya karegi isme?

**Coach (as Salesperson):** Sir, humari POS Machine yahi problem solve karti hai. Conductor har passenger ko machine se ticket deta hai. **Har ticket ka record apne aap ban jaata hai.** Ab jo bhi collection hua, wo aapke phone pe dikh raha hai — live.

Aur ek cheez sir — machine ke saath **Business App bilkul free** milti hai. Aapke phone pe. Ye dekhiye 👇 Aaj ka poora collection. Har trip ka hisaab. Kaunsi bus ne kitna kamaya. Sir aap 10th pass ho ya graduate — isse farak nahi padta. **Sab picture jaisa dikhta hai.**

[CHIP: Iska kitna kharcha hai?] [CHIP: Mera conductor nahi chala payega]
Iska kitna kharcha hai?

**Coach (as Salesperson):** Sir price main abhi bata dunga, chhupa nahi raha. 😊 Par ek second — pehle ye batao. Agar mahine mein **aath hazaar ki leakage** band ho jaaye, toh machine ka kharcha aapko mehnga lagega ya sasta?

[CHIP: Sasta lagega, par batao toh] [CHIP: Conductor nahi chala payega]
Conductor nahi chala payega

**Coach (as Salesperson):** Sahi chinta hai sir, aur aap pehle nahi ho jo ye poochh rahe ho. Machine mein bas do-teen button dabane hote hain — jitna phone chalana aata hai, utna kaafi hai. Aur hum **training dete hain**, machine dene ke baad. Free. Aur agar kabhi dikkat aayi — **24×7 support** hai sir. Ek call, ho gaya.

Sir ek kaam karte hain — kal main aapki ek bus pe **live demo** dikha deta hoon. Conductor ke haath mein deke dekhte hain. Pasand aaye toh baat aage, nahi toh koi baat nahi. **Kal subah theek rahega ya shaam?** 🤝

[CHIP: Subah theek rahega] [CHIP: Shaam ko aa jana]
Subah theek rahega

**Coach:** Perfect, kal milte hain. 🎬 **Scene khatam.**

Rohit, ab Rajesh ji ki kursi se bahar aa jao. 😊 Sach batao — **kaunsi line pe aap thoda ruk gaye the?** Jahan laga 'arre, ye toh sahi bol raha hai'?

[CHIP: Conductor wali baat] [CHIP: Phone pe dikhega] [CHIP: 8 hazaar ka calculation]
8 hazaar ka calculation

**Coach:** 🎯 **Bilkul. Aur wahi poore pitch ka dil hai.**

Dhyan do — maine ek baar bhi shuru mein feature nahi bola. Maine ek **sawaal** poocha. Aur us sawaal ne Rajesh ji ke andar wo dard khol diya jo wo kisi ko batate bhi nahi.

Maine paanch cheezein ki — ye aapki checklist hai:
1. **Permission maangi:** 'do minute maangunga, chalega?'
2. **Sawaal se shuru:** 'collection kaise pata chalta hai?'
3. **Dard khola:** 'poora hai, ye kaise pata?' (phir chup ho gaya)
4. **Solution + free app dikhaya:** bataya nahi, screen dikhayi
5. **Price ko value se joda:** '8 hazaar bachega toh mehnga hai ya sasta?'
6. **Chhota next step maanga:** demo maanga, order nahi

Ab aapki baari. Ab main Rajesh Yadav banunga, aur aap pitch karoge. Same aadmi, same mood.
